card.name: Linking words around heparin terms
card.fires_on: Small linking words (or, other, weight, containing, of) that sit right before or inside a heparin or low molecular weight heparin mention, mostly in anticoagulant labels.

modes.label: Heparin or LMWH lists
modes.description: Words like or, other, weight joining heparin with low molecular weight heparins.
modes.example: Do not exchange with heparin<< or>> other LMWHs.

modes.label: Inside low molecular weight
modes.description: The word weight in the phrase low molecular weight heparin.
modes.example: heparin, low molecular<< weight>> heparin, and other drugs known

modes.label: Before citrate or heparin dose
modes.description: A linking word just before citrate or heparin sodium in blood-tube or dosing text.
modes.example: collect blood samples in tubes<< containing>> citrate.
